title: Conformal Local Influence Screening with clis
text: Classical local influence diagnostics rank observations curvature measure ask analyst inspect index plot points “stand ”. workflow two well-known weaknesses. First, scale: thousands observations, index plot becomes unreadable underlying n×nn \times n eigenproblem becomes expensive. Second, offers control error rate: principled threshold guarantee proportion false declarations. clis package addresses problems zero--one inflated beta (BIc) regression models. uses conformal normal curvature observation non-conformity score inside split-conformal testing procedure. result per-observation conformal pp-value whose Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment controls false discovery rate (FDR) level choose, running linear time per observation single model fit.

title: Conformal Local Influence Screening with clis
text: use bundled vaccination dataset: national DTP3 immunisation coverage proportions 2022, point mass one (countries complete coverage). dataset ships package vignette builds without external dependencies. paper’s applications use ReadingSkills data betareg package (one-inflated, small sample) lungFunction data gamlss.data package (one-inflated, large sample); script data-raw/application.R reproduces , data-raw/README.md gives runbook paper’s tables figures. fit one-inflated beta model variable dispersion: inflation probability depends Human Development Index, conditional mean log GDP urbanisation, precision log GDP log population.

title: Conformal Local Influence Screening with clis
text: practice recommended sequence : (1) fit model; (2) look classical influence index plot see shape influence, exactly traditional beta-regression diagnostics; (3) run conformal screen obtain error-controlled declaration; (4) use block decomposition localise effect; (5) repeat seeds stable report.  index plot answers “influence look like?”; screen answers “points can declare influential controlling false discovery rate?”; intersection seeds gives deterministic report.
code: # (2) classical index plot -- the familiar picture, no error control plot_influence(fit, labels = vaccination$iso3c) # (3) error-controlled screen at FDR 10% res <- clis_screen(fit, alpha = 0.10, seed = 1)  # (5) stability across seeds: keep declarations that persist decl <- lapply(1:10, function(s)   clis_screen(fit, alpha = 0.10, seed = s)$influential_global) stable <- Reduce(intersect, decl) vaccination$iso3c[stable] #> character(0)

title: Conformal Local Influence Screening with clis
text: conformal pp-values marginally valid , null screening point exchangeable (clean) calibration set, rank score uniform. Bates others (2023) showed resulting pp-values positively dependent, Benjamini-Hochberg procedure controls FDR. modelling assumption beyond BIc fit calibration set predominantly free influential points, holds approximately whenever influential observations rare.

title: Conformal Local Influence Screening with clis
text: covariate effects nonlinear, submodels can use penalised additive terms (example P-splines via pb() gamlss). screening procedure works penalised information J + S, false discovery rate guarantee unchanged: numerical scores differ. Pass penalised = TRUE clis_screen(), extracts penalty bic_penalty() reports effective degrees freedom. reported effective degrees freedom replace nominal parameter count split inflation part mean/precision part, mirroring block decomposition influence scores.
code: fit_s <- gamlss(   dtp3 ~ pb(ln_gdp) + urb,   sigma.formula = ~ pb(ln_gdp) + ln_pop,   nu.formula    = ~ pb(hdi),   family  = gamlss.dist::BEOI,   data    = vaccination,   control = gamlss.control(trace = FALSE) ) res_s <- clis_screen(fit_s, alpha = 0.1, penalised = TRUE, seed = 1) res_s

title: Conformal Local Influence Screening with clis
text: smoothing parameters chosen outer criterion gamlss fit (REML GCV). false discovery rate guarantee hold exactly, smoothing parameter break exchangeability calibration scores: selecting calibration split, separate auxiliary split, sufficient. Selecting full sample introduces mild dependence low-dimensional global quantity, whose effect realised FDR negligible practice. REML stable default; GCV can undersmooth small sample sizes.

what: clis: Conformal Local Influence Screening for Bounded-Response Regression — clis-package
title: clis: Conformal Local Influence Screening for Bounded-Response Regression — clis-package
text: Provides fast, statistically calibrated influence diagnostics zero--one inflated beta (BIc) regression models variable dispersion. core idea use conformal normal curvature Poon Poon (1999) doi:10.1111/1467-9868.00162  non-conformity score within split-conformal testing procedure, yielding per-observation conformal p-values whose Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment controls false discovery rate user-specified level (Bates others, 2023) doi:10.1214/22-AOS2244 . Unlike classical local influence diagnostics, rely visual inspection index plots scale beyond hundred observations, 'clis' provides finite-sample error guarantee runs linear time per observation single model fit. Methods four perturbation schemes, block decomposition influence inflation-probability conditional-mean/precision components, penalised additive (semiparametric) submodels, full suite diagnostic plots included.

title: Conformal Local Influence Screening — clis_screen

CLIS addresses limitations: conformal wrapper supplies finite-sample FDR guarantee, per-observation score computed linear time single model fit. calibration set assumed predominantly free influential observations. influential points typically rare, random split satisfies approximately; adversarial settings, robust pre-filter can applied calibration.

title: clis 0.3.2
text: Documentation: regenerated man/ roxygen sources. 20 exported functions now help pages; clis_screen() documentation includes calib_idx penalised arguments, missing. Packaging: removed empty data/ directory unused LazyData field; bundled vaccination data loaded inst/extdata via load_vaccination(). README example corrected accordingly. title: clis 0.3.1
text: Fix: added bic_quantile_residuals(), correct randomized quantile residual BEZI/BEOI. generic residuals() mishandled inflation atom one-inflated (BEOI) fits, making every residual share sign; plot_residuals() envelope_bic() now use corrected version.

title: clis 0.3.0
text: Scalability: clis_screen() default B_Et score now uses linear-time algorithm never forms n x n curvature matrix. 67,000-observation fit influence scores compute second, dense n x n construction needs ~33 GB fails. New exported cnc_scores_linear() exposes path directly, cnc_block_decomp() rewritten linear-time well. m_r aggregate score still uses dense eigendecomposition now guarded options(clis.max_dense_n=) (default 5000) avoid accidental --memory build large samples.

title: clis 0.2.3
text: Fix: print.clis summary.clis now registered S3 methods, print(res) summary(res) dispatch correctly. clis_screen() gains calib_idx argument supply explicit, trusted calibration set. conformal guarantee requires calibration set (nearly) free influential points; random split can let outliers leak calibration suppress power, clean subset known supplied via calib_idx. Simulation scripts revised: response clamped strictly one (zero-inflated beta admits [0, 1) , draws exactly one made gamlss reject response), influential points planted response contradicts covariate (genuine influence rather accommodated leverage), screening uses large clean calibration set. validated running package R 4.3.3 gamlss real AlcoholUse data simulated data.

title: clis 0.2.2
text: Fix: influence computations longer require model fitted x = TRUE. design matrices now recovered via gamlss model.matrix method (manual fallback), bic_info(), clis_screen(), plots work standard gamlss fit. cause silent per-replication failures simulation scripts. simulation scripts now surface first real error entire cell fails, instead returning non-numeric result downstream.

title: clis 0.2.1
text: New data-raw/sim-fdr-power.R reproduces linear-model false discovery rate table detection-power curves. New data-raw/sim-classical.R reproduces classical sensitivity analysis figure. New data-raw/README.md gives runbook reproducing every table figure paper. Worked examples now use real AlcoholUse data zoib package, matching paper’s application.

title: clis 0.2.0
text: Semiparametric extension: penalised additive submodels. bic_info() gains penalty argument penalised information J + S, reports effective degrees freedom block split. New bic_penalty() assembles block-diagonal penalty matrix smooth terms fitted additive gamlss model. clis_screen() gains penalised argument; false discovery rate guarantee carries penalised fits. New reproducibility script data-raw/sim-semiparametric.R semiparametric simulation (FDR control, curve recovery, effective degrees freedom REML GCV smoothing). New plot_influence() reproduces classical local-influence index plot (curvature vs. observation index cutoff labels), style beta-regression diagnostics literature. New data-raw/application.R reproduces paper’s application real AlcoholUse data (zoib package): fit, classical index plot, conformal screening, semiparametric refit.

title: clis 0.1.0
text: Initial release. clis_screen(): conformal local influence screening finite-sample false discovery rate control zero--one inflated beta regression. Conformal normal curvature scores via cnc_matrix() cnc_scores(). Block decomposition influence inflation vs. mean/precision components via cnc_block_decomp(). Four perturbation schemes: case-weights, discrete-covariate, mean-covariate, precision-covariate. Diagnostic plots: plot_clis(), plot_cnc_panels(), plot_residuals(), envelope_bic(). Bundled vaccination dataset (national DTP3 coverage, 2022).
